description.en: The npm package name of the channel plugin, including the version number.
The ID of the channel plugin.

description.zh: 升级后是否重启网关，默认true
description.en: Specifies whether to restart the gateway after the upgrade. The default value is `true`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb upgrade-polar-claw-channel --application-id pa-00000000000000 --channel-id feishu --plugin-id openclaw-feishu --npm-package @larksuite/openclaw-feishu@2026.4.7 --channel-config dmPolicy=open allowFrom=["0","ou_abc"] enabled=true --restart true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb UpgradePolarClawChannel --region cn-hangzhou --NpmPackage '@larksuite/openclaw-feishu@2026.4.7' --ChannelConfig '{"dmPolicy":"open","allowFrom":["0","ou_abc"],"enabled":true}' --ApplicationId 'pa-00000000000000' --ChannelId feishu --PluginId 'openclaw-feishu' --Restart true
